title: Juicy Spicy Dutch Chicken Kebabs
description: A spicy and silky monsoon Dutch dish featuring sunflower oil and tandoor flavors, this recipe is onion and garlic free, and the kebabs are wrapped in corn husks.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sunflower oil, tandoor spice mix, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Soak the corn husks in water for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and thread 3-4 pieces onto each corn husk.
Wrap the corn husks around the chicken and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Place the kebabs in the tandoor or oven and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the kebabs hot with a side of yogurt sauce.
To make the yogurt sauce, mix together the yogurt and a pinch of salt and pepper.
